prompt: Some people think that homeschooling should be banned because it has several drawbacks. Others think that it has a number of benefits. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some are of the opinion that homeschooling ought to be prohibited due to its disadvantages, whereas others believe that it has several advantages. In my opinion, I consider that homeschooling is a great educational method which can benefit both parents and students. 

On the one hand, according to some, family-led education can result in a number of pitfalls. One of the main reasons is that when children are homeschooled, they will lack  social skills. In other words, going to school gives students the opportunity to mix with other children which can undoubtedly help them to develop their communication skills. However, if children study at home, they will most likely be alone most of the time. This will clearly impact their personalities negatively. Another reason why some oppose the idea of homeschooling is that it can be costly. Although parents can teach their children at home, not all parents have the knowledge to teach all subjects to their children. As a result, they have to hire private tutors to teach their children. In this case, they have to spend a lot of money, and for those who have financial issues, this can definitely affect their budgets. 

On the other hand, some people claim that home-based learning can bring about a number of merits, and I agree. Firstly, this educational method helps students learn effectively. That is to say, parents or tutors can slow the lesson based on their children' or students' performance. For instance, if students are weak in science, a teacher can slow down the lesson to ensure that they master the lesson effectively. Nevertheless, in a normal class, this cannot be done because a teacher has to follow the curriculum of the school. Secondly, with this educational option, parents can monitor their children's behaviour. These days, many children behave badly because they are affected by their peers. When children are at home with their parents, they can monitor them most of the time, and therefore, they will behave well. 

To sum up, while people may vary in their opinions, I think that homeschooling should not be banned owing to its positive aspects. If homeschooled were promoted, children would not only perform well academically but  also would have great personalities.
